fit_robust_scaler: fit a RobustScaler on GPU tensor data using quantile-based center and scale computation
transform_standard_scaler: transform feature data with a StandardScaler that normalizes per channel or globally
fit_batch_scaler: fit a BatchScaler on multiple DataLoaders to compute per-recording MEG and feature scalers
transform_segment_batch: transform a SegmentBatch by normalizing MEG signals and features using fitted BatchScaler
get_categorical_feature_weights: get inverse frequency weights for a categorical feature to rebalance CCE loss
